app-skill-loader-unify.title: Unify AppSkillRepository to use SkillFrontmatterParser
app-skill-loader-unify.description: Refactor AssetAppSkillRepository to use the shared SkillFrontmatterParser instead of its own FRONTMATTER_REGEX. After this change, both Agent Skills and App Skills go through one parser. Optional but tidier — eliminates duplicate frontmatter-stripping code, gives app skills the same validation (lowercase-hyphen name, description bounds, etc.). Depends on frontmatter migration because the parser will reject old-format names (com.android.settings has dots, fails name regex).
acceptCriteria: AssetAppSkillRepository.load() uses SkillFrontmatterParser to strip frontmatter and return body
FRONTMATTER_REGEX removed from AppSkillRepository.kt (no duplicate frontmatter handling)
Skills with malformed frontmatter return null with log warning
./gradlew testDebugUnitTest succeeds (existing AssetAppSkillRepositoryTest passes after migration)
